name: Antique Broken English
effect: Every altered answer falls into simple, faintly 18th-century English ("any thing", "hath", "Mr. Shakspeare", "occasion", "observed", "diligence"). It keeps drifting to the weather: wind, air, how hot or cold the day is, even for bicycles an
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 20/20 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
